_note: Story 8.3 UJ-3 fixture. The domain (warehouse shipments / carriers) is absent from seed/schema.sql and the seed corpus, so the first prompt finds no similar query. Table names are deliberately non-conventional (wh_ prefix) so an ungrounded model cannot guess them.
first_prompt: late shipments per carrier this month
follow_up_prompt: which carriers had the most late shipments this month

saved.title: Late shipments per carrier this month
saved.description: Shipments delivered after their promised date, counted per carrier for the current month.
saved.sql_content:
SELECT c.carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS late_shipments
FROM wh_shipments s
JOIN wh_carriers c ON c.carrier_id = s.carrier_id
WHERE s.delivered_at > s.promised_at
  AND s.shipped_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY c.carrier_name
ORDER BY late_shipments DESC
